title: skills: objectstack-ai SKILL.md should teach delete_record confirm: true (after #30813)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czvZykUqhYxYXSSDt4

Follow-up from card #30813 (PR #30861, BREAKING). After that PR, MCP `delete_record` refuses any call without `confirm: true` and answers `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, in the same refusal shape `run_action` uses. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Stale line:** `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` L202, in the tools table, still says only "`delete_record` is annotated destructive". An agent that follows the skill sends no `confirm` and gets refused.

**Expected:** the row says that `delete_record` needs `confirm: true`, and that the agent asks the user before it sets it. Same wording rule as `run_action`'s confirmation member.

**Serial:** after PR #30861 merges, so the skill never teaches an argument the server does not yet read.

**Landing:** Tier H (`skills/**`), and the changeset owes `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. Suggested grade p2, because the skill teaches a call that the platform refuses once #30861 lands.
